changelog:
1. Fix face detection failure on Rockchip devices - added rotation fallback (tries 0/90/180/270 degrees), upgraded to ACCURATE mode, lowered min face size
2. Add diagnostic logging for face analysis pipeline (image size, rotation, detection results)
3. Fix OTA signature conflict detection - guides user to uninstall old version when signatures mismatch
4. Fix OTA check-update false positive when config fetch fails
